activations.name: Validator seat lock and airdrop schedule
activations.summary: Seeded validator seats keep their one-year lock; airdrop tranches follow the emission start.

activations.name: Scheduled-change safeguards
activations.summary: A scheduled change runs only under the rules that apply to its own operation.

activations.name: Named agents
activations.summary: Named agents with policies, signatures bound to this chain's genesis, and trading safety fixes.

activations.name: Two-round batch commit
activations.summary: Each batch is committed in two voting rounds (prepare, commit).

activations.name: Bridge vault
activations.summary: Deposits and withdrawals through the vault on Arbitrum One, attested by the validators.

activations.name: Cancel-on-disconnect switch
activations.summary: An account can have all its orders cancelled at a time it keeps refreshing.

activations.name: Market-maker upgrade
activations.summary: Order types, batch orders, self-trade prevention and the market-maker tier.

activations.name: Margin at fill price
activations.summary: Margin is reserved at the price an order can fill at; a price band through the mark.

activations.name: Open-interest caps and owner-only money moves
activations.summary: Orders and fills that would take a market past its open-interest cap are refused (closing and reduce-only are not); every asset move needs the owner's own signature; creating a vault costs a fee paid to the treasury.

activations.name: Stop orders, fee settings and partial liquidation
activations.summary: Stop, take-profit and stop-loss orders rest on chain and fire when the mark reaches their trigger; the perps taker and maker fees are owner settings; an isolated position is liquidated in part where that restores it.

activations.name: Per-market order limits
activations.summary: Each market carries its own largest limit order, largest market order, largest order value and largest position per account, set by the owners; an order over a limit is refused at submission and at apply with its code.

releases.notes: Release 8dc00864f09c7d88 reads the Arbitrum vault through two separately keyed endpoints that must agree on the block hash and on the values read at that block, and checks each read against the vault's running totals: a surplus is accepted with a warning, an unexplained decrease is refused until cleared, and an unreadable read record is set aside. These checks are in the node's read layer only: consensus rules, activation heights and the signer daemon are the same as df1116da247abf5f. Rollback: df1116da247abf5f at any height.
